title: 第3章 三花河畔第4章 老子是镖人不是奴人
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: 洛璃咬着唇，沉默了两秒，最终还是点了点头。
她爷爷早已是油尽灯枯之躯，大限将至，根本没有时间再去帮她寻找更有真本事的镖人了。
而她此行，需要的不仅仅是武力，更重要的是一个可靠之人。
她转过身，收起眼中的情绪，冲着陈观规规矩矩的欠了欠身，语气温柔，却透着股疏离。
“那这一路，便有劳陈大哥了。”
陈观眼不瞎，早看出来这小姑娘对自己一肚子的不满。
这也是稀奇，他走了十年镖，还是头一回被雇主这么嫌弃，而且还是个毛都没长齐的小丫头片子。
只要钱到位，他倒是不介意。
反正一路山高水长，有的是机会让她好好认识自己。
“陈镖师，那今日我们便回去准备一下，”
老丈拱了拱手，“明日一早，三花河畔，咱们不见不散。”
陈观点了点头，随后干脆利落的拿出一本皱巴巴的书籍递给洛璃，提醒道。
“没问题，在最后一页按上手印。”
洛璃接过，目光落在封皮上那两个歪歪扭扭的——《路约》。
她眉头蹙了蹙。
谁家契约这么厚一本？
不过既然她爷爷已经确定了，她也不好说什么，翻到最后一页。
最后一页上面密密麻麻全是手印，她伸出一根大拇指，在陈观递来的印泥上蹭了蹭。
带着一副不属于她这个年纪的干脆利落，在下面空白位置，轻轻一按。
【已接受任务：护送洛璃前往大周上京城】
【可使用技能：得加钱】
【效果】：走镖途中，可因情况跟镖主坐地起价要求价钱，成功一次，任务镖点增加10％。
目送那一老一少相互搀扶着消失在山下的小河边，陈观深吸了一口气，收回目光后，神色难得多了几分凝重。
这一趟，赌的可不仅仅是那一百二十两银子，赌的是命。
也是他这十年来，一直渴望却从未踏出的那一步——去看看这山沟沟外面的世界。
“张叔，”
陈观转头，看向还在发愣的张老汉，“这只兔子处理一下，晚上咱们爷俩……不醉不归。”
张老汉回过神，重重点头。
他知道这个小子留不住了。
如果，他不是被全村人一口稀粥一口饼子拉扯大，十年前恐怕就已经离开了。
能在这村里帮衬大家十年，也算是仁至义尽。
雏鹰长好了翅膀，必然会回到它的天空。
何况这方圆几百里的第一高手，怎可浪费在这山沟沟里？
他没有大声宣扬，也没说什么矫情的送别话，只是默默地拎起那只足有五斤重的肥兔子，转身朝着村里走去，背影显的有些落寞。
content_en:
;;
Luo Li bit her lip, was silent for two seconds, and finally nodded.
Her grandfather has long since exhausted his energy and his life is approaching. He has no time to help her find a more capable escort.
And what she needs for this trip is not just force, but more importantly, a reliable person.
She turned around, put away the emotions in her eyes, and bowed politely to Chen Guanrui, her tone gentle, but revealing a sense of alienation.
"Then I will have to thank Brother Chen for your troubles along the way."
Chen Guan was not blind and had already noticed that this little girl was dissatisfied with him.
This is also strange. He has been an escort for ten years, but this is the first time he has been so disliked by his employer, and he is still a little girl with no hair.
As long as the money is there, he doesn't mind.
Anyway, the road has been full of ups and downs, and there are plenty of opportunities for her to get to know herself well.
"Master Chen, let's go back and make preparations today."
The old man cupped his hands and said, "Tomorrow morning, we will meet at the Sanhua River."
"Okay!"
Chen Dian nodded, then neatly took out a crumpled book and handed it to Luo Li as a reminder.
"No problem, just put your thumbprint on the last page."
Luo Li took it and her eyes fell on the two crooked words on the cover - "Lu Jiao".
She frowned.
Whose contract is so thick?
But now that her grandfather had confirmed it, she couldn't say anything and turned to the last page.
The last page was densely covered with fingerprints. She stretched out a thumb and rubbed it on the ink pad Chen Guan handed her.
With a crispness that did not belong to her age, she pressed lightly on the empty space below.
[Quest accepted: Escort Luo Li to the capital of Great Zhou Dynasty]
[Available skills: need to add money]
[Effect]: During the dart journey, you can ask the escort master for a price due to circumstances. If you succeed once, the mission dart points will increase by 10%.
Watching the old man and the young man supporting each other and disappearing by the river at the foot of the mountain, Chen Guan took a deep breath, and after looking away, his expression became more solemn.
This time, the stakes were not just the one hundred and twenty taels of silver, but also lives.
It was also the step he had longed for but never taken in the past ten years - to see the world outside this valley.
"Uncle Zhang,"
Chen Guan turned his head and looked at Old Man Zhang, who was still in a daze, "Take care of this rabbit, and we will not return until we get drunk tonight."
"Okay!"
Old man Zhang came back to his senses and nodded heavily.
He knew he couldn't keep this kid.
If he hadn't been brought up by the whole village eating porridge and pancakes, he might have left ten years ago.
Being able to help everyone in this village for ten years is considered to be the most benevolent thing.
When the young eagle has grown its wings, it will inevitably return to its sky.
What's more, how could the number one master within a radius of hundreds of miles be wasted in this ravine?
He didn't make a loud announcement, nor did he say any pretentious farewell words. He just silently picked up the fat rabbit, which weighed five kilograms, and turned around and walked towards the village. His back looked a little lonely.
title_en: Chapter 3 By the Sanhua River Chapter 4 I am a bodyguard, not a slave
